question: Which honour was conferred upon cricketer R Ashwin by President Droupadi Murmu at Rashtrapati Bhavan in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Shri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian cricketer **Ravichandran Ashwin** (R Ashwin) was conferred with the **Padma Shri**, India's **fourth-highest civilian award**, by President **Droupadi Murmu**.
 
• The ceremony took place at the **Rashtrapati Bhavan** in New Delhi during the **Civil Investiture Ceremony** held in **April 2025**.
 
• R Ashwin was recognized for his exceptional contribution to the **field of Sports**, particularly for his career as one of the most successful **off-spinners** in the history of **Test cricket**.
 
• Ashwin is widely regarded for his tactical intelligence and has achieved significant milestones, including becoming the **second Indian bowler** to surpass **500 Test wickets**.
 
• The award acknowledges his long-standing dedication to **Indian Cricket** and his role in numerous victories for the **Indian National Team** on the international stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The Padma Awards:** 
 
 
• These are among the highest civilian honors of India, announced annually on the eve of **Republic Day** (**January 26**).
 
• The awards are given in three categories: **Padma Vibhushan** (for exceptional and distinguished service), **Padma Bhushan** (distinguished service of high order), and **Padma Shri** (distinguished service in any field).
 
• The awards are conferred by the **President of India** at ceremonial functions held at **Rashtrapati Bhavan** usually around March or April.
 
 
 
• **R Ashwin’s Cricketing Profile:**
 
 
• Born in **Chennai, Tamil Nadu**, Ashwin made his international debut in **2010**.
 
• He was a vital member of the Indian squad that won the **2011 ICC Cricket World Cup** and the **2013 ICC Champions Trophy**.
 
• He is the fastest bowler to reach several wicket milestones in **Test cricket**, including **250, 300, and 350 wickets**.
 
• Apart from his bowling, he is known for his batting capabilities, having scored multiple **Test centuries**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Previous Accolades:** Before receiving the **Padma Shri**, R Ashwin was honored with the **Arjuna Award** in **2014** for his outstanding performance in sports.
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna:** He also received the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** (formerly Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna) in **2021**, which is the **highest sporting honor** in India.
 
• **ICC Rankings:** Ashwin has frequently occupied the **Number 1 spot** in the **ICC Men’s Test Player Rankings** for both bowlers and all-rounders.
 
• **Selection Process:** The recommendations for **Padma Awards** are made by the **Padma Awards Committee**, which is constituted by the **Prime Minister** every year. The committee is headed by the **Cabinet Secretary**.
 
• **Other Options:** 
 
 
• **Padma Vibhushan:** The second-highest civilian award; usually reserved for exceptional national service.
 
• **Padma Bhushan:** The third-highest civilian award.
 
• **Arjuna Award:** A dedicated sports award for consistent performance over four years, which Ashwin received earlier in his career (**2014**).
